ios.desc:
Build a habit you can see.

Read a little. Write a page. Move your body. Unbroken Chain turns each completed day into a bold mark on your calendar, so your progress is easy to see and your next step is clear.

PICK ONE GOAL. KEEP SHOWING UP.
Create a goal, choose the weekdays that fit your routine, and tap the calendar when you finish. Track every day or only the days you choose.

SEE YOUR CONSISTENCY GROW
Follow your consecutive-day streak and total completed days. Review earlier months, and mark or unmark past tracked days when you need to correct your history.

A REMINDER WHEN IT MATTERS
Set an optional reminder for your scheduled goal days. A small nudge helps you remember the reading, writing, exercise, or other routine you want to make time for.

FOCUSED BY DESIGN
A clean, dark calendar keeps attention on your goal. Goal history is stored locally on your device, with no account needed to start tracking.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
Download and track one goal for free. An optional Premium subscription unlocks unlimited goals, so you can keep separate chains for different routines. Premium is available monthly or yearly.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Manage or cancel your subscription in App Store account settings.

Start with one small action. Add your next link today.

quotes.text:
Yep, Unbroken Chain ( http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/unbroken-chain/id415158247?mt=8 )

I released it in January just thought it would be interesting to see the usage stats, I haven't checked in forever!

Goals Added:  17,642
Chains Added:  247,104

Kind of cool to see actual usage from someone other than me!

# of goals added is pretty obvious, but # of chains added probably bears a little explanation: Every day you do something is a chain - I probably should have called it a link in the stats system.

As pithy as that seems, it really is the best way to overcome procrastination.  Just do it.  Just do something that moves you closer to your goals.  Pick just one little thing and get it done.  Then pick something else and get it done.  Once you've started getting momentum (even just a little bit of momentum), pick the most important thing and get it done, then rinse and repeat.

It's going to sound like I'm trying to plug my newest app (http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/unbroken-chain/id415158247?mt=8), and I suppose I am, but that's one of the reasons that I wrote it:  to help me make sure that I am moving closer to my goals each and every day.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What do you do to counteract procrastination?
